name: Minimal Gallery Page – Simple Custom Post Type Gallery
author: Edgars V

sections.description:
Minimal Gallery Page is a simple and minimal WordPress gallery plugin built for users who want a clean, fast, and distraction-free way to display images.

Instead of relying on shortcodes or page builders, the plugin creates a custom post type gallery that integrates naturally into WordPress. Each gallery automatically gets its own single page gallery view, along with a generated gallery archive page that lists all galleries.

This plugin is ideal if you’re looking for a really simple gallery, a minimal gallery plugin, or a lightweight custom post type based image gallery without unnecessary features or visual clutter.

Galleries are easy to manage from the WordPress admin using a familiar drag-and-drop image interface. On the frontend, galleries are displayed using responsive, optimized layouts that work seamlessly on desktop and mobile devices.

Minimal Gallery Page is perfect for portfolios, photography websites, and anyone who wants a single page gallery for each collection of images – clean, fast, and easy to maintain.

Features

  • Simple and minimal image gallery plugin
  • Custom post type gallery for structured image management
  • Automatic gallery archive page
  • Single page gallery view for each gallery
  • Drag-and-drop image management
  • Optimized image sizes for performance
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly gallery layout
  • Customizable gallery URL slug
  • Clean frontend templates with no bloat
  • Theme-friendly and easy to override
  • Automatic permalink flushing when slug changes
  • Translation ready

Usage

  1. Go to Gallery > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Enter a title and optional description for your gallery
  3. Click “Add images” in the Gallery Images meta box
  4. Select multiple images from your media library
  5. Click “Add to gallery”
  6. Publish to create a single page gallery

Visit Gallery > Settings to customize the gallery URL slug and access the gallery archive page.

Custom Image Sizes

  • minigp_single_gallery – 1230px wide (single gallery view)
  • minigp_list_gallery – 500x500px (gallery archive/listing)

Theme Integration

You can override the default gallery templates by copying them into your theme.

Supported template files:

  • gallery-single-style-1.php- Single gallery template
  • template-gallery-1.php – Gallery archive template

For Sage / Blade themes:

  • your-theme/resources/views/templates/minimal-gallery-page/gallery-single-style-1.blade.php
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Minimal Gallery Page”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Go to Gallery > Settings
  2. Customize the gallery URL slug if needed
  3. Start creating galleries via Gallery > Add New
sections.faq:
How do I add images to a gallery?

Go to Gallery > Add New, enter a title, then click “Add images” in the Gallery Images meta box. Select multiple images and click “Add to gallery”.

Can I change the gallery URL structure?

Yes. Go to Gallery > Settings and change the Gallery Slug. This controls both the gallery archive and single page gallery URLs.

Do I need to flush permalinks manually?

No. The plugin automatically flushes permalinks when the slug is changed. If needed, you can manually visit Settings > Permalinks and click “Save Changes”.

How do I view all galleries?

You can view all galleries on the frontend via the gallery archive page, or manage them in the admin under Gallery > All Items.

Can I customize the gallery templates?

Yes. The plugin supports template overrides in your theme. See the Theme Integration section above for file paths.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is fully translation ready using the text domain “minimal-gallery-page”.
